classification.difficultyReason: Relate a fitted sphere to the cylinder's radius and height, then calculate a volume percentage.

content.prompt: A ball just fits inside a cylinder. What percentage of the volume of the cylinder is taken up by the ball? Round your answer to the nearest whole percentage.

spec.description: Unshaded sphere fitted inside a cylinder, with solid silhouettes and front rims, dashed equator and rear bottom rim, and black top and bottom contact points. Source blue outlines and red construction curves are rendered black with their distinct dash roles retained.
spec.mathematics: Cylinder radius equals the ball radius; cylinder height equals the ball diameter.
spec.answerVisibility: No derived dimensions or answers appear.

answer.worked:
Let the ball's radius be $r$. The cylinder has radius $r$ and height $2r$.
$$\begin{align*}V_{\text{ball}}&=\frac43\pi r^{3}\\V_{\text{cylinder}}&=\pi r^{2}\times2r\\&=2\pi r^{3}\\\text{Percentage}&=\frac{\frac43\pi r^{3}}{2\pi r^{3}}\times100\%\\&=\frac23\times100\%\\&\approx67\%\end{align*}$$
